southwest_monsoon.title: Official Long Range Forecast for Southwest Monsoon Seasonal Rainfall
southwest_monsoon.issuing_office: National Weather Forecasting Centre, IMD New Delhi
southwest_monsoon.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecasts the seasonal rainfall over the country as a whole to be in the Above Normal category (>104% of Long Period Average). Favorable spatial distribution is expected across Central India and South Peninsular India, with near-normal precipitation over Northwest and East-Northeast India.

South Peninsular India.subdivision: South Peninsular India (including Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana)
South Peninsular India.notes: Favorable monsoon circulation supported by anticipated La Niña development in the equatorial Pacific and neutral Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) conditions.

Central India.subdivision: Central India (Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, Odisha)
Central India.notes: Enhanced convective activity expected across the core agricultural belt.

Northwest India.subdivision: Northwest India (Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh)
Northwest India.notes: Precipitation within normal climatological bounds (92-108% of LPA).

East & Northeast India.subdivision: East and Northeast India (Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Assam, Arunachal Pradesh)
East & Northeast India.notes: Subdued precipitation probabilities across several northeastern valleys.

northeast_monsoon.title: Official Seasonal Outlook for Post-Monsoon / Northeast Monsoon Rainfall over South Peninsular India
northeast_monsoon.issuing_office: Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC), IMD Chennai / NWFC New Delhi
northeast_monsoon.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) issues the official seasonal outlook for Northeast Monsoon (October to December) rainfall over South Peninsular India (Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Rayalaseema, Kerala & Mahe, and South Interior Karnataka). Seasonal rainfall is projected to be Normal to Above Normal (88-112% of Long Period Average).

Tamil Nadu.notes: Major contributor to annual precipitation in coastal and delta districts. Active cyclonic disturbances and easterly wave pulses will govern episodic high-rainfall spells.

Kerala.notes: Intermittent post-monsoon showers and thunderstorm activity during October-November.

Andhra Pradesh.notes: Rainfall largely dependent on low-pressure systems and depressions forming in the Bay of Bengal.

Karnataka.notes: Moderate rainfall during early post-monsoon transition.

monitoring_advisories: Monitor district-level rainfall distribution bulletins released bi-weekly by IMD Agromet Advisory Services (GKMS).
Track Bay of Bengal low-pressure system and depression advisories before scheduling critical field harvesting.
Verify root-zone soil moisture before initiating post-monsoon sowing or broad-acre planting.
Inspect farm pond spillways and field bund drainage channels to buffer heavy localized downpours.
Consult local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Assistant Agricultural Officer (AAO) for block-level contingency plans.
